turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

भाई… ये सुनकर दिल भारी हो गया। पाँच हफ्ते तक तुमने रोज़ एक पूरा “normal life” का show चलाया है — बैग, café, 6 बजे तक बाहर — ये छोटी बात नहीं है। और शायद layoff से ज़्यादा अब secrecy का बोझ तुम्हें खा रहा है।

तुम गलत इंसान नहीं हो। तुम डरे हुए हो, शर्मिंदा हो, control बचाने की कोशिश कर रहे हो। पर अब ये secret तुम्हें protect नहीं कर रहा — तुम्हें अकेला कर रहा है।

मेरी राय: सबसे पहले wife को बताओ। Parents को अभी नहीं — जब तुम दोनों तय करो कि कैसे और कितना बताना है।

Wife से ऐसे कह सकते हो:

> “मुझे ये बात बताने में बहुत डर लग रहा था, इसलिए मैंने छुपाया। पाँच हफ्ते पहले मेरी layoff हुई थी, और ये performance की वजह से नहीं थी। मैं रोज़ café जा रहा था क्योंकि मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा था कि घर पर कैसे बताऊँ। मुझे तुम्हारी मदद चाहिए — शायद सिर्फ सुनने की, शायद plan बनाने में।”

आज का goal पूरा confession नहीं होना चाहिए। बस एक honest 15-minute conversation start करना।

एक सीधा सवाल भी पूछूँ: तुम safe हो? मतलब कभी ऐसा लगता है कि खुद को नुकसान पहुँचा लोगे? अगर हाँ, तो अभी किसी को physically पास बुलाओ — wife, parents, neighbour, anyone — और emergency help लो। तुम्हें इस वक्त अकेले नहीं रहना चाहिए।

अगर चाहो तो मैं तुम्हारे लिए wife से बात करने की exact wording बना देता हूँ — soft, dignified, बिना drama के।

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Bhai, yeh “kamra” tumhare dimaag mein isliye chal raha hai kyunki tum sirf job nahi kho rahe — tum family ke saamne “successful beta” wali image bhi kho rahe ho. Aur shaadi mein woh image public ho jaayegi. Yeh pressure bohot real hai.

Pehle ek cheez: **tumhe shaadi mein jaana hai ya nahi, yeh tumhari mental health ke hisaab se decide hona chahiye, “log kya sochenge” ke hisaab se nahi.**

Agar jaana hai, toh plan ke saath jao. Ready-made lines rakho:

> “Haan, main abhi transition phase mein hoon. Company mein restructuring hua, meri team affect hui. Main next role dekh raha hoon. Details mein abhi shaadi mein nahi jaana chahta.”

Agar koi zyada dabaye:

> “Aapki concern samajh sakta hoon. Main already working on it. Aaj celebrate karte hain.”

Aur papa se shaadi se pehle quietly bol do:

> “Papa, agar koi company ke baare mein pooche, toh please bol dena ki main transition mein hoon. Mujhe public correction handle karna mushkil lagega. Main aapko disappoint nahi kar raha, bas sach time par batana chahta hoon.”

Salary/package/next company — kisi ko mat batao. Rishtedaar curiosity ke naam par pressure daal dete hain.

Aur neend ke liye aaj raat bas yeh likh lo:

1. “Main jobless nahi, transition mein hoon.”
2. “Mera value sirf company ke naam se nahi hai.”
3. “Shaadi mein mujhe sirf 3 lines bolni hain, debate nahi karni.”

Aur haan — wife ko batana ab aur zaroori ho gaya hai. Shaadi mein tum dono ek team ki tarah honge. Agar woh andar se nahi jaanti, toh tum double load carry kar rahe ho: job search + secret.

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Bhai, skip karne ka thought **galat nahi** hai. Kabhi kabhi body aur dimaag bolte hain: “Main ab aur public exposure nahi handle kar sakta.” Yeh cowardice nahi hai.

Par ek baat: **panic se decision mat lena.** Tumhare paas 3 raaste hain:

### Option 1: Shaadi jaao — but with a strict exit plan
Sirf 1–2 ghante. Wife ko pehle bata do:  
> “Mujhe shaadi mein uncomfortable lagega. Agar main bolun ‘chai?’ ya ‘thoda bahar chalte hain’, please leave kar dete hain.”

Relatives se line:
> “Haan, abhi transition phase mein hoon. Company restructuring thi. Main next role dekh raha hoon. Details baad mein — aaj celebrate karte hain.”

Zyada pooche toh:
> “Aapki concern samajh sakta hoon. Main handle kar raha hoon. Aap bas cousin ke liye happy rahiye.”

### Option 2: Skip karo — without creating a big fake office story
Agar jaana tumhe genuinely break kar dega, toh skip karna bhi valid hai. But “office deadline” jaisa bada jhooth tumhe andar se aur khaayega.

Cousin ko simple:
> “Bhai, is time main mentally/health-wise itna stable nahi hoon ki bada function handle kar paun. Main tumhe personally call karunga. Please mera naam leke explanations mat dena.”

Papa ko quietly:
> “Papa, main shaadi mein nahi aa paunga. Main explain nahi karna chahta. Please logon se kuch elaborate mat bolna.”

### Option 3: Wife ko ab bata do
Shaadi se pehle wife ko bata dena sabse strong move hai. Uske bina tum “husband + employee + son + performer” sab banne ki koshish kar rahe ho. Yeh bohot heavy hai.

Usse bas itna bolo:
> “Mujhe tumse ek baat kehni hai jo mujhe sharam aur darr dono de rahi hai. Main layoff ke baad café ja raha tha kyunki tumhe bata nahi pa raha tha. Ab shaadi ka pressure bhi aa raha hai. Mujhe tumhari help chahiye.”

Aur haan — **tum ek shaadi se “story” nahi ban jaoge.** Log do din baat karte hain, bhool jaate hain. Tum khud apne aap ko roz roz courtroom mein khada kar rahe ho.

Ek chhota check bhi: agar neend na aane ke saath kabhi aisa lage ki tum khud ko nuksan pahuncha loge, toh please abhi wife/parents/neighbor ko physically paas bula lo. Is waqt alone carry mat karo.

Chaaho toh main tumhare liye **wife

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Bhai, main tumhe jhootha nahi bulaunga. Tumhara logic **timing ka lagta** hai, par ek jagah se crack ho raha hai: tum sirf apni timing control kar rahe ho, wife ki choices/control ko delay kar rahe ho.

Tumhara “offer aate hi bata dunga” ek understandable survival strategy hai. Darr, shame, family pressure, EMI — sab milkar tumhe bolne nahi de rahe. Par emotionally, yeh ab **information asymmetry** ban gaya hai. Matlab ghar ka sabse bada financial truth tumhare paas locked hai, aur wife uske basis par normal life jee rahi hai.

Yeh zaroori nahi ki tum aaj hi parents ko bata do. Par **wife ko jald batao** — ideally 24–48 ghante mein. Kyunki:

- 3 mahine ka runway hai, aur job search bhi time legi.
- Agar offer late aaya, toh crisis tab bhi same rahega, bas discussion late hoga.
- Wife ke paas bhi planning ka haq hai: expenses, parents, EMI, shaadi, future.
- Tum dono ek team ho. Abhi tum solo captain ban kar baith gaye ho.

Offer aane ka wait mat karo. **Offer aane ke baad batana “relief” hoga, lekin trust ka cost pay karna pad sakta hai.**

Ek clean way:

> “Mujhe tumse ek financial baat karni hai. Main darr ke maare timing perfect karne ki koshish kar raha tha. Paanch hafte pehle meri layoff hui thi. Main roz café ja raha tha kyunki tumhe bata nahi pa raha tha. Humare paas roughly 3 mahine hain. Main job search kar raha hoon, lekin main chahta hoon ab se hum mil kar plan banayein.”

Phir 3 cheezein rakho:

1. **Sach**: layoff kab hui, severance/benefits kya hain.
2. **Numbers**: monthly EMI/expenses, runway, emergency fund.
3. **Plan**: applications per week, network, interview prep, cutbacks, parents ko kab/kya batana hai.

Aur haan, “crisis nahi” banane ke liye offer ka wait karna mat. Crisis ko **managed transition** banana hai — aur woh sirf tum dono milkar kar sakte ho.
